title: Diabetes
text: Diabetes is a long-term condition involving high blood glucose. General symptoms may include increased thirst, frequent urination, tiredness, blurred vision, and unexplained weight change. Symptoms alone do not confirm diabetes. Testing and professional assessment are required.

title: High Blood Pressure
